title.en: Fable 24 — The Donkey in the Lion's Skin

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: חמור מצא עור של אריה בשדה.
sentences.en: A donkey found a lion’s skin in a field.
A hunter left it there in the morning.
The donkey put it on his back.
He looked at himself in the water.
He said: now I am a lion.
He went to the field of the village.
The cows saw him and ran away fast.
The sheep ran among the trees.
The donkey was very happy and laughed.
He went from house to house in the village.
The children ran and closed the doors.
The women shouted from the windows.
He wanted to say something to them.
He opened his mouth and cried out.

sentences.ar: הקול שלו היה קול של חמור.
sentences.en: His voice was a donkey’s voice.
Everyone stood and then began to laugh.

sentences.ar: האיכר בא ולקח לו את העור.
sentences.en: The farmer came and took the skin from him.
The clothing changes, and the voice does not.
